articles.summary: Representational image. articles.title: Hoymiles India Ties Festive Visit to Setu Foundation to Its ‘Open Energy for All’ Message
articles.summary: Hoymiles India celebrated the festive season with children supported by Setu Foundation, sharing sweets and spending time together. Setu’s work improves access to education, healthcare and skills for underserved communities. The visit reflected Hoymiles’ commitment to community engagement and its “Open Energy for All” message, emphasising that happiness and energy are best shared. The company plans further partnerships to advance energy transition and decarbonization across India. articles.title: SECI Cancels Tender for Two Agri-PV Projects on Agricultural Land in Delhi
articles.summary: Representational image. Credit: Canva " /> The Solar Energy Corporation of India has annulled its tender for leasing two agricultural land parcels in Delhi to develop agri-photovoltaic power plants. Issued on September 9, 2026, the procurement aimed to combine farming with solar generation. SECI provided no cancellation reason or confirmed plans for a replacement tender, urging bidders to monitor future announcements.
